game_moneyline_spread.rederivation_notes: My chain before reading the record: margin = possessions x (opponent-adjusted AdjO/AdjD gap) + venue term (home ~3-4, neutral 0) with sd ~10-11; mean uncertain early season (portal churn, preseason prior); availability mixture; blowout compression and late-fouling inflation; OT as a spike at small margins; contracts read different parts of one margin pmf (winner, .5 spread tail, 6-10 bucket, SGP joint with total). Required: rating posterior, preseason prior, injuries/lineups, venue/neutral, tempo/variance, coach bench-clearing, margin-total covariance, rules text (48h void, OT wording). The record matches this well and adds unrated-opponent prior and snapshot discipline. Differences: I would not leave market-implied strength inside cbb.ratings as primary, and several series mapped here (CBC, HL, MARMADREGION, SGP, D3GAME) are not plain game-margin contracts. Rules checked: SPREAD/WINMARGIN/SGP text and 48h clause quotes are correct; OT is truly unstated for full-game text.

game_total.rederivation_notes: My chain: total = possessions (negotiated tempos, possession length, whistles) x combined points per possession (adjusted offence vs defence, shot mix, regressed 3P/FT luck) + OT tail (~5-6% of games, +10-12 points) + late-foul add in close games; sd ~11-12; availability alters pace and efficiency; league scoring drift; officials. KXNCAAMBOT is a separate count contract: P(tie at 40:00) then repeated ties; 3+ periods about 1 in 500-1000. Settlement hazards: OT inclusion in the total not stated, 48h void to fair price, nested .5 rungs. The record covers all of this, including a distinct OT tie chain and possession-length input, which I had not separated. Differences are minor: four_factors tagged DUPLICATE_OF adj_off though used as a stage input; venue demoted to context; the claimed KenPom APL fields and Torvik on/off splits are unverified (author flags APL). Rules quotes verified verbatim against KXNCAAMBTOTAL and KXNCAAMBOT samples; the OT-not-stated claim is correct.

team_total.rederivation_notes: My chain: team points = shared possessions x own points per possession (own offence vs this defence, scheme, FT drawing) + OT; coupled to margin by role (favourite capped by bench play, underdog lifted by late fouls); home/neutral venue shifts each team's own scoring; availability directional (own scorers, opponent rim protection); ladder of nested .5 strikes and joint with the opponent's ladder. Required: adj_off/adj_def, tempo with pace control, venue/neutral, injuries, blowout coupling, FT propensity. The record has all but venue, and adds pace elasticity, bench efficiency and margin coupling well. Difference: venue is missing and declared as an environment GAP rather than fixed, though cbb.venue exists in the catalog and is used in sibling archetypes. Also catalog's implied_team_totals (market-derived, primary) was correctly demoted to BENCHMARK_ONLY. Rules quotes for the 89.5 strike and 'fair price' clause verified.

first_half.rederivation_notes: My chain: 20-minute half, ~32-35 possessions per side, starters play most minutes; half margin sd ~7, tie ~5% so 1H winner is three-way with an integer pmf at zero; early-foul benching and opening lineup; half pace is not half of game pace; bonus structure at 7th/10th team foul resets each half. Second-half series (2H winner, spread, total) include OT, so 2H = game minus 1H plus OT plus late fouling and blowout truncation; they trade live through halftime so 1H state matters. Pregame 2H pricing needs the full-game script inputs (blowout, late-foul, OT). Record covers 1H very well (tie pmf, pace ratio, foul-bench rule) and adds a halftime-state update. Differences: 2H pregame mechanism is thin, one sentence is wrong (only first half has bonus structure), and the 1H spread/total secondary text is a copy of the 2H OT note which is not noted. Quotes verified; the absence of the 48h clause in half-market text is correctly flagged.

findings.text: Three of six live series are 2H markets (KXNCAAMB2H, 2HSPREAD, 2HTOTAL) that include overtime, but the audited input list has no input for the 2H pregame distribution: late_game_foul_script, ot_model and blowout_garbage appear only in stage s6 text, not among audited/new inputs of this archetype. A pregame 2H total/spread is game expectation minus 1H expectation plus foul-game and OT terms; these should be explicit required inputs.

Stage s4 states 'only the first half has this clock-driven closing structure'; wrong - bonus entry at team foul 7/10 resets each half and the 2H adds intentional fouling (the same record says so in the pace-ratio text). Also contradicts the 2H need above.

KXNCAAMB1HSPREAD and KXNCAAMB1HTOTAL secondary text reads 'Note: 2nd half markets are inclusive of overtime.' (a template carry-over on 1H markets). The record asserts 1H never includes OT as VERIFIED; it follows from 'in the 1st half' in the primary text but the anomalous note is not recorded as a CONTRACT_AMBIGUOUS item.

player_points.rederivation_notes: My chain for a points ladder: availability -> minutes mixture (blowout, fouls) -> shot attempts (usage x pace, teammate absences) -> conversion with heavy luck regression -> FT trips incl. late-game -> overdispersed integer outcome; settlement hazards DNP void/NO, OT, stat source. But the only live series (KXNCAAMBFIRST10/25/50, KXNCAAMBRACE 'Race to N Points') are TITLE_ONLY and almost certainly race markets (first to N points), most plausibly team-level as on other Kalshi basketball race contracts; I could not verify. If team-level, the required inputs are opening-lineup scoring rate, tip/arrow possession, pace and adj_off, not player minutes/usage. The record builds the full single-player ladder and discloses the race ambiguity (pp_race_who) but keeps the player-ladder inputs primary and the race profile as context. Rules cannot be checked; the record correctly says NOT_VERIFIED.

findings.text: Archetype/series mismatch drives the input list: every live series under this key is a 'Race to N Points' title. cbb.race_early_scoring_profile is role=context while the 15+ player-ladder inputs are primary. If the races are team-level (likely), the primary input set (player_minutes, usage, shooting regression, FT trips) is irrelevant to every live contract; if player-level, the first-passage structure is the primary object. Either way the roles are inverted for live contracts. Resolve by reading Kalshi rules for KXNCAAMBFIRST25 before relying on this list.
No per-player points ladder exists in the ledger; settlement_contract is GAP (disclosed) but all stage text (DNP 3-8%, 25+ rungs) is for a hypothetical contract.

player_props.rederivation_notes: My chain for a generic counting-stat prop: appearance (DNP causes) -> minutes/role state -> per-minute opportunity rates by stat (hierarchical, transfer cold start) -> opponent/pace supply -> conversion/recording -> discrete overdispersed distribution with cross-stat dependence for combos; settlement hazards DNP, OT, provider. No live series exists, so there is no contract text; inputs are inferred from sport knowledge. The record's chain matches mine and adds cold-start prior, role-stable effective sample, DNP cause taxonomy and scorekeeper bias. Differences: scorekeeper bias is a speculative input labelled context (appropriately), and the whole archetype cannot be tied to rules. Nothing found that blocks using the input list as a candidate requirement set, but it is unvalidated against any contract.

player_rebounds_assists.rederivation_notes: My chain: minutes and who shares the floor -> rebound pool (both teams' misses, location of misses, crash vs get-back) x player share against floor competition; assists = creation share x teammate conversion with scorer discretion; shared game-level shooting shock with opposite sign on assists and rebounds; negative-binomial counts and a copula for a rebounds+assists combo. No live series. Record matches, adding ball-handler succession and miss-location mix. Differences: loadings (+0.6/-0.5) and variance ratios are asserted, though disclosed as unestimated; the claim that team rebounds are credited to team lines varies by provider is plausible but unverified. No blockers to the input list.

player_threes.rederivation_notes: My chain: participation and minutes -> three-point attempts (role, assisted catch-and-shoot dependence on creators, pace, opponent scheme, game script with trailing teams shooting more) -> make probability (shot quality, skill with FT% proxy, heavy shrinkage with ~100-200 attempt priors) -> beta-binomial/NB compound; rungs read the tail; zero mass from low-attempt games. No live series; the season-long three-pointers-per-game leader (KXNCAAMBSTATLEADER) is a different contract. Record agrees and adds an opponent attempts-vs-percentage persistence split and trailing-attempt lift. Differences: three_pt_luck is tagged DUPLICATE_OF player_shooting_regression though one is team-level and one player-level; persistence 0.5-0.6 and 15-30% lift are unverified (author flags both). No blocker.

futures_champion.rederivation_notes: My chain: title = P(field) x P(seed/region) x product of six neutral-site win probabilities (probit of rating gap over ~10.5 sd) with star-injury shocks and March-strength drift; convex in strength so uncertainty fattens the tail; conference tournaments are small brackets with league-specific byes/hosting and an auto-bid; regular-season champion and reach-the-final are different path events; sum of probabilities across teams = 1. Required: rating posterior, strength drift, bracket sim, field format, conf format table, injuries, resume/auto-bid for field membership. Record matches except the field-membership inputs, and its seven-object description of the archetype is a good catch. Differences: market-implied strength embedded in cbb.ratings, field-membership inputs missing, a baseball series left in. Rules: KXMARMAD, KXMARMADROUND 'does not end up competing' quote, KXNCAAMBBIGEASTQUAL, IVY verified; 'Round of 76' flagged by author.

Required: strength posterior with correlation, schedule/venue inventory, standings sim, bracket sim, committee seed inputs. Record matches on the first four and adds tie-cutoff and shared-strength inputs. Differences: market-implied component in cbb.ratings, and seed series have no committee/resume inputs. Rules quotes verified verbatim (tie-inclusive, neutral-site, regular-season-only).

futures_seed_other.rederivation_notes: My chain: seed and field membership are produced by a human committee ranking teams from team-sheet metrics (NET, quadrants, WAB, SOR, predictive ratings) into an S-curve with bracketing constraints; field membership = rank inside at-large cutoff after bid thieves; seed bands are step-like with 15-30% neighbour mass; round-reached events follow a bracket simulation conditional on seed. Required: resume metrics by date, revealed-preference ordered probit, auto-bid/thief count, protocol vintage, injuries treatment. No live series is attached, so there is no rules text; the five seed series sit under futures_conference. Record agrees and is detailed (remaining-game leverage, recency weighting). Differences: the record is for hypothetical contracts; cbb.ratings still carries the market-implied component and committee_seed_model bundles an expert consensus. No blocker for the input list as a requirement set.

unreg:polls_and_awards.rederivation_notes: My chain, four processes: (1) AP poll series: distinct #1 count over ~19-20 polls is a path-dependent process driven by top-team losses and voter leapfrogs; KXNCAAMBAPANY is a running-minimum of rank; final-poll series depend on tournament outcomes. (2) KenPom series: deterministic list at a timestamp (Mar 15 2027 12:00 EST; DST begins Mar 14, so ambiguous), uncertainty from games before then and gaps at the cutoff; paywalled settlement source. (3) Awards: candidate set x selection, MOP = title probability x within-team share, co-recipient payout 1/N rounded down, No if the player does not play. (4) Stat leaders: season per-game averages including postseason with NCAA minimums, a selected maximum with winner's curse. Record matches all four and the DST catch is correct. Differences: market-implied component in cbb.ratings (primary), conference stat-leader counts all games not just conference games (not stated), source accessibility claims unverified.
